title: Right Tonight
style: Jazz-pop swing at 120 BPM with walking bass, brushed drums, smoky Rhodes chords, and crisp horn punches; verse glides in with sparse trio phrasing, pre-chorus lifts with syncopated claps and held piano voicings, chorus opens with stacked vocal harmonies and sax replies. Lead vocal stays close-mic and conversational, with scattered ad-lib echoes and a short scat tag after each hook. Warm, polished mix with intimate low-end and bright horn sparkle., jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They said, "You won't"
I said, "Watch me move"
Hands on the wheel
Clean cut, clean groove

New shoes on the floor
Fresh plan in my chest
I been down before
Now I do it best

[Pre-Chorus]
No more talk
No more doubt
I keep calm
And I walk it out

See my name
On the line
I don't flinch
I just shine

[Chorus]
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight
Let them watch me rise
Do it right tonight

Say I can't, say I won't
I don't hear that noise
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight

[Verse 2]
Old words fade
When the truth walks in
Cold eyes turn soft
When the work begins

Every scar
Got me here
Every miss
Made it clear

I built this slow
Brick by brick
Now the whole room knows
I'm the one that sticks

[Pre-Chorus]
No more talk
No more doubt
I keep calm
And I walk it out

See my name
On the line
I don't flinch
I just shine

[Chorus]
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight
Let them watch me rise
Do it right tonight

Say I can't, say I won't
I don't hear that noise
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight

[Bridge]
Let the room go still
When I step in place
Every little no
Turns into my praise

I was built for this
You can see it now
Whole world leaning in
When I hold it down

[Chorus]
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight
Let them watch me rise
Do it right tonight

Say I can't, say I won't
I don't hear that noise
Do it right tonight
Do it right tonight

[Outro]
Right tonight
Right tonight
Proof in my hands
Right tonight
